title: .ticfac/ run-state store: checkpoint, attempt, decision, evidence with compare-and-swap against origin
description:
internal/runstate: writer/reader for .ticfac/runs/<run-id>/{checkpoint.json, attempts/<n>.json, decisions/<n>.json, evidence/<key>.json} per contracts/ticfac-run-state.json and the evidence record in job-protocol.json (nested provenance, closed). Persistence policy: durable means pushed on origin; every write is commit + push in one operation on the EpicRun integration branch; create-if-absent for attempts and SHA-guarded update for checkpoints implemented exactly as the 7 executable CAS sequences (git push --force-with-lease on the local host); a conflict is a typed outcome, not an error to retry blindly. Checkpoint only on state change. Terminal state places the tag ticfac/run-<run-id>. .gitignore fragment installed (index and logs ignored). Tests: the contract sequences run against the REAL git (temp bare origin), plus the schemas.

## How this fits
You own internal/runstate. The 7 CAS sequences live in contracts/ticfac-run-state.json and are already executed over a git fake in parity; yours must run them against a REAL temp bare origin. The executor (qg5) and tk client (y7o) are concurrent siblings — do not depend on them.

Integration branch epic/qeu already contains wave 1 (tick b6s, commit 38889bad1fd725a897bd1a4fd75ef41217d3acfa): Go module github.com/pengelbrecht/ticfac (stdlib-only, go 1.24), the vendored contract bundle 3.0.0 under contracts/ (NEVER edit it; go test refuses local edits), internal/schema (ParseSchema/ParseDefs/Validate — the validator to use for every bundle document; its refusal strings are contract surface), internal/contracts (Dir()/RepoRoot() locate the bundle from any test depth), and internal/contracts/parity with one reader per bundle file — including a test-scoped CAS fake (parity/cas_fake_test.go) and lifecycle harness (parity/lifecycle_harness_test.go) that your real implementation must agree with. Read README.md, CONTRACTS.md and the RESULT of wave 1 in git history (commit message of 9a3faa3) before starting. Three ticks run in parallel in this wave (qg5 executor, xkd run-state store, y7o tk client); stay inside your own package directory, do not touch go.mod (no third-party deps — stdlib only), README.md, or files owned by the other two. Verify your base: git merge-base --is-ancestor 38889bad1fd725a897bd1a4fd75ef41217d3acfa HEAD.
